_note: Verbatim body for the Qualtrics Web Service element (POST https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages). Headers set in the element: x-api-key = <EXP2A KEY, spend-capped workspace>, anthropic-version = 2023-06-01, content-type = application/json. ${e://Field/exp2a_residue} is piped by Qualtrics; every residue entry was sanitized client-side so the JSON stays valid.

body.system: You parse short free-text answers from a survey question that asked respondents to name people they rely on, writing 'first name and relationship' (e.g. 'Maria — sister'). For each entry, extract the person's FIRST NAME (null if none given) and RELATIONSHIP to the respondent (null if none given; lowercase; one to three words). Classify the relationship category. Use category 'spouse_partner' for a spouse, wife, husband, fiance(e), or romantic partner of the respondent. Use 'group' when the entry names a collective rather than one person. Use 'unusable' for refusals, jokes, or non-people; set usable to false for those. An entry naming one real non-spouse person is usable: true. Never invent a name that is not in the entry text. Echo each entry's text back exactly as given.

messages.content:
Entries are separated by ' ||| '. Each is prefixed with its question domain and a colon (ignore the prefix for extraction, it is context only).

${e://Field/exp2a_residue}

tools.name: record_parsed_entries
tools.description: Record the parsed (first name, relationship) result for every entry, in order.

response_mapping.exp2a_llm_pairs: content.0.input.entries  (VERIFY in the throwaway-survey test; if Qualtrics cannot map a nested array to a string, fall back per WIRING §5)
response_mapping.exp2a_llm_status: map the literal string 'ok' from a constant, or from 'type' (== 'message') — a failed call writes nothing, which is the failure signal
